name: volute
author: grids-agent
description: MEDIUM. Grid of lowercase letters (3-6 rows x 3-7 cols). The answer is the grid read off in a clockwise inward spiral starting at the top-left and heading right. The scorer recomputes the spiral with the peel-the-top-row-and-rotate one-liner and compares strings. Discovery path: the answer is obviously a permutation of the grid's letters (same multiset, same length), so the whole game is 'which traversal order?'. Live hypothesis space: row-major, column-major, boustrophedon by row or column, diagonals, spiral CW/CCW, inward/outward, different start corners. Row-major is the natural first guess and scores 0; the single demo reveals the order immediately, and after that it is a five-line implementation. Rated medium because without the demo a team can burn several rounds on the wrong traversal, and because spiral indexing is the kind of thing bots get subtly wrong on non-square grids.
solve:
def solve(clue):
    g = clue.split()
    o = ''
    while g:
        o += g[0]
        g = [''.join(x) for x in zip(*g[1:])][::-1]
    return o
